habitat: Montane forests and forest edges at 900–1700 m
story: In the diverse world of birds, the Whiteheads Broadbill (Calyptomena whiteheadi) stands out. This species, part of the Calyptomenidae family, is a resident of Montane forests and forest edges at 900–1700 m. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Whiteheads Broadbill is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Whiteheads Broadbill and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
